description: Full profile of one convention by slug: dates, venue and address, website, artist-alley and vendor registration windows/costs/URLs, every published price tier (artist spaces, dealer booths, badges; this edition and past ones) with its source, portfolio and table-share policy, hotel block, transit access, organizer verification, and up to 6 years of attendance/pricing history. Get slugs from artistally_search_conventions or an ArtistAlly event URL.

slug.description: Convention slug, e.g. "otafest" — the last segment of an ArtistAlly /events/ URL.

name: artistally_get_convention
title: Get convention details

description: The regions, states/provinces, and metro areas ArtistAlly tracks, with approved-convention counts. Use it to learn valid region/state/metro filter values for the other tools. Takes no arguments.
name: artistally_get_coverage
title: Get coverage map

description: Artist-alley and vendor/dealer registration windows that are open right now or opening soon, sorted by urgency (soonest close date first). The go-to tool for questions like "which cons can I still apply to?" or "what artist alleys open this month?".

community.description: Filter by community: furry, anime, gaming, or multi (multi-genre).

region.description: Coverage region, e.g. "Southeast", "Midwest", "West Coast", "Canada". Valid values come from artistally_get_coverage.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code, e.g. "GA", "TX", "ON".

type.description: Which registration kind to include. Default: both.

within_days.description: Look-ahead window in days for "opening soon". Default 30.

name: artistally_list_open_registrations
title: List open registrations

description: Search fan conventions (furry, anime, gaming) across 51 US and Canadian metro areas. Returns upcoming conventions by default (soonest first); set include_past to search the archive too. Filter by text, community, region, state, metro, or date range. Returns dates, venue, location, registration windows and table costs, plus a canonical ArtistAlly URL per convention.

community.description: Filter by community: furry, anime, gaming, or multi (multi-genre).

include_past.description: Include conventions that have already finished (default false). Past results are still sorted soonest-first; use starts_after/starts_before to target a specific year.

query.description: Free-text match on convention name, venue, or city, e.g. "Otafest" or "Atlanta".

region.description: Coverage region, e.g. "Southeast", "Midwest", "West Coast", "Canada". Valid values come from artistally_get_coverage.

starts_after.description: Only conventions starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

starts_before.description: Only conventions starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code, e.g. "GA", "TX", "ON".

name: artistally_search_conventions
title: Search conventions
